name: Icon of the Seas
verdict: Crowd management works better than the size suggests. Specialty dining is where the real money goes.
goodAt: Neighbourhood layout that spreads guests out
Families with a wide age range
watchFor: Peak-week crowding at the pool deck

name: Star of the Seas
verdict: Icon's layout with a second year of fixes applied. The closest thing to a refined mega-ship.
goodAt: Everything Icon does, with fewer teething problems
watchFor: Same specialty dining spend as Icon

name: Legend of the Seas
verdict: Third Icon-class ship. Mediterranean this summer, Fort Lauderdale for winter.

name: Wonder of the Seas
verdict: The Oasis formula at its most polished, and still the better choice if you want Central Park.

name: Utopia of the Seas
verdict: Short-sailing specialist out of Port Canaveral. Built for three and four night trips.

name: Harmony of the Seas
verdict: Amplified and still one of the best value Oasis-class options.
goodAt: Value against the newer Icon ships

name: Freedom of the Seas
verdict: Redeploying to Southampton for summer 2027 after 20+ Miami sailings were cancelled.
goodAt: Smaller footprint than the Oasis ships
